semantic_role_features.sem_name_sim: Maps directly to field_similarity__0 (Name in Family A, Full Name in Family B)
semantic_role_features.sem_identifier_sim: Maps to field_similarity__3 (id_number) in Fam A, and field_similarity__1 (registry_id) in Fam B
semantic_role_features.sem_date_sim: Maps to field_similarity__1 (dob) in Fam A, and field_similarity__4 (registration_date) in Fam B

finding: Semantic features are deterministic re-indexings and aggregations of the existing 5 field similarity slots. Trees in A0 already learn these non-linear splits natively, yielding zero ranking gain (0.9729 vs 0.9729).
